plugins.name: prompt-optimizer
plugins.description: /optimize rewrites a draft prompt with repo context and fills it into the composer

plugins.description: /handoff summarizes the session into a prompt a fresh session can pick up; --new continues it in a fresh session

plugins.description: ADHD output style: answer first, short chunks, one next step
